claim_text: The pinned native CLI has no delta parameter: help omits `--delta`, invoking it exits 2, and the source hard-codes the 2.0-point decision branch. A synthetic fixture with derived raw margin 2.0000000000000018 is rounded to 2.0 and classified READABLE, while the R2 candidate instructs a reader to treat equality as MARGINAL. A different fixture has point margin 13.6364 and 95% interval [-100.0, 21.124], yet remains READABLE. Domain-mismatch, two-generator floor and no-reading controls still return refusals, and two accepted runs are byte-identical.
